info.title: Cherry Magic! Thirty Years of Virginity Can Make You a Wizard?!
info.synopsis: All'età di trent'anni, Adachi è ancora un uomo vergine, che tuttavia ha sviluppato lo speciale potere di leggere nella mente delle persone, semplicemente sfiorandole. All'inizio, Adachi viene sopraffatto dal suo potere, salvo scoprire che una tale abilità non gli è affatto utile nella vita. Dopo aver sfiorato accidentalmente il suo bel collega di lavoro Kurosawa, Adachi apprende che l'uomo ha una cotta per nient'altri che lui!

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: 30-year-old virgin Kiyoshi Adachi discovers he has the ability to hear people's thoughts when he touches them. It's mostly a daily annoyance, until his powers reveal that his handsome and popular coworker Yuichi Kurosawa only has eyes for him!

tmdb.title: Episodio 1

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Adachi asks his friend and romance-novelist, Tsuge, for advice on his predicament. At work, Adachi uses his power to help Kurosawa. They have an awkward exchange while out drinking with their coworkers.

tmdb.title: Episodio 2

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: While at a company party, Kurosawa recognizes that he is becoming jealous when other people give Adachi attention. Adachi learns that despite his outward composure, Kurosawa has underlying anxiety, which Adachi finds relatable. After an awkward experience in a sauna, Kurosawa reflects on how he came to develop a crush on Adachi. Adachi tells Kurosawa that being around him has helped him to develop self-confidence.
